reviews.review_title: Amazing game, but there are some issues.
reviews.review_description: First off, the game is pretty fun and is the first gorilla slop game to actually feel somewhat good to play, unlike animal company which feels nothing like its inspiration (lethal company), this game really reminds me of it and its honestly so cool. Now for the problems which EVERY game has problems cause no game is perfect, the monsters are really annoying, despite them actually being scary, you will often find them camping you which makes it pretty annoying to get to places, they usually go after the first person they see until it kills them which can be pretty useful at times but its still annoying to me. Another problem i have is the physics, I'm constantly getting stuck on things and it ruins the game for me, its also pretty hard to grab things sometimes. Now the quests; they simply suck, the quests take some time mainly for new players and they also reward almost nothing. And finally the micro transactions, it doesn't annoy me too much, but why do i have to pay about TEN DOLLARS to make quests actually good. That's all i really have to say besides the problems watering down the game a bit.

This game is decent for being such a new game, although there are some bugs, the game is still pretty playable. The other users in the game are nice, it’s easy to find people to grind with and the crafting mechanic is pretty good for how simple it is. Overall, this game is pretty fun.
